name: woori_server
implemented: NestJS src/common + src/domain + src/admin + independent worker structure
local PostgreSQL 16 migrations and restricted woori_api runtime role
scrypt password authentication, hashed revocable web sessions and Origin protection
one-time account-bound email verification; private development mail files and Resend adapter
membership-scoped groups and album reads; atomic owner membership on group creation
hashed invitation code/link, owner controls and serializable bounded/idempotent joining
database-backed request limiting and explicit verified proxy-hop configuration
pure notification eligibility policy; isolated PostgreSQL integration tests
member-scoped album creation and READY photo pagination
private R2 presigned staging PUT, bounded image validation and metadata-stripped variants
current-membership authenticated photo content proxy, lease-fenced completion and group quota reservation
actual R2 upload/variant reads, original checksums, browser CORS and browser upload flow verified with isolated local PostgreSQL
owner-only album title update/deletion and active owner/uploader photo deletion
transactional tombstones and quota release, upload completion/deletion fencing, permission summaries
durable media cleanup queue with expiring worker leases, verified private object deletion and retry
persisted general/pin comments with bounded cursor pagination and author/owner permission summaries
one emoji reaction per user/photo with atomic replacement/removal and bounded allowlist
transactional active-membership and READY-photo authorization against deletion and revocation races
atomic photo/comment/pin/reaction notification inbox persistence with self exclusion and event deduplication
recipient/current-target scoped inbox pagination, unread counts and observed-sequence read marking
account/group notification preferences with optimistic version checks and quiet-hours/time-zone validation
session-bound AES-GCM encrypted Web Push subscriptions with strict provider allowlist and logout revocation
transactional notification outbox and fenced delivery worker with bounded retries, quiet-hours holding and current eligibility checks
opaque provider payload followed by authenticated display validation; generic lock-screen text by default
actual Chrome Web Push receipt verified for two fixture accounts using real provider transport; account switch cleanup and revoked-membership deep-link denial verified
Resend verification email received in Gmail and actual email link confirmed in Chrome; database verification and temporary account cleanup verified

name/email account recovery with generic responses and rate limits; hashed one-time 30-minute reset tokens with transactional session/push revocation and login-race fencing; current-user profile name update
active-member roster with minimal fields and bounded pagination; owner-scoped rename/removal/ownership transfer/deletion and member leave
group-first transactional locking across invitations, album writes and lifecycle changes; serializable raw SQL conflict retry
durable bounded group cleanup integrated with media worker, quota consistency, retry and late-publication reopening; real R2 group deletion verified with isolated synthetic fixture
membership-scoped today/month memories with fixed Korean UTC+09 calendar, leap-day policy, bounded cursor pagination and per-user hide/restore
manual capture date above validated EXIF above upload date; owner/uploader editing with date-source labels and restore
real R2 EXIF upload and bounded existing-photo backfill verified with synthetic images; manual date preserved during concurrent backfill
durable uploader-scoped photo processing queue with fenced worker retries, quota and membership/delete race checks; legacy synchronous complete endpoint retained
bounded local read-only DB/R2 photo-prefix reconciliation report; no automatic orphan deletion
60MP image validation, bounded sharp cache/concurrency, real 48MP JPEG and EXIF orientation tests
authenticated password/email changes with current-password reauthentication, single-use account-bound email confirmation and all-session/push revocation
member account deletion with ownership preflight, password reauthentication, atomic identity/private-record erasure, shared-content retention and fresh-signup isolation
read-only published notices; member inquiries with own list/detail and exact rolling 24-hour limit; operator-only photo/comment/member reports with own status list

personal one-directional user blocks hiding blocked members' photos, comments, reactions, memories and notifications/push for the blocker only; block-time notification erasure; roster blockedByMe and photo uploader exposure

separate public nickname and private recovery name; NFC-normalized 2–20 character duplicate-friendly signup/profile nicknames; neutral legacy aliases with update prompt flag; nickname-only social projections and account deletion erasure
notImplemented: production end-to-end acceptance of the Lightsail API/worker deployment (sign-up mail, media, push, admin) (W07)
Lightsail daily R2 backup schedule, latest-success monitoring and production restore drill
native FCM/APNs subscriptions and dispatch (web push upload/reaction bundling is implemented)
production Web Push setup and iPhone/Android physical-device receipt verification
global bucket orphan inventory and automatic orphan deletion
HEIC pixel decoding and physical-device photo workflow validation
operator identity, privacy contact, retention periods and finalized privacy policy text (placeholders shown)
manual album cover selection (automatic cover and album date range are implemented)
server-side album search and taken-date sort; taken-date sort is demo-only (album cursor pagination is implemented)
group join approval and join notifications (enum/preference only)
admin group mutation and ownership transfer (suspended group owner limitation)
audit-log, report and inquiry retention periods (undecided)
join notifications, join approval, memory pushes, manual album cover, server album search/taken-date sort (after beta)

runtimeConfiguration.WEB_ORIGIN: local http://localhost:3210; production exact HTTPS web origin
runtimeConfiguration.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: comma-separated exact origins; required for browser mutations
runtimeConfiguration.TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: 0 locally; 1 only for a verified single trusted proxy topology
runtimeConfiguration.MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: separate migration connection; explicit migrate/prepare only
runtimeConfiguration.MAIL_MODE: file for local files without external email; resend for actual email after provider setup
runtimeConfiguration.DEV_MAIL_DIR: optional; blank uses current user's ~/.woori/dev-mail; override must be absolute and outside repository; development only
runtimeConfiguration.RESEND_API_KEY: server secret for Resend mode; never NEXT_PUBLIC
runtimeConfiguration.envLoading: dev/start/migrate scripts load gitignored .env; DB compose loads .env.local-db
runtimeConfiguration.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: S3 credential scoped to the private development bucket
runtimeConfiguration.R2_BUCKET: private R2 Standard bucket; public access disabled
runtimeConfiguration.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: public P-256 VAPID key returned to authenticated browser config
runtimeConfiguration.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: private stable VAPID key shared by API/worker; never expose
runtimeConfiguration.WEB_PUSH_VAPID_SUBJECT: mailto: real operator contact or HTTPS contact URL
runtimeConfiguration.PUSH_ENCRYPTION_KEY: base64 32-byte AES-GCM key shared by API/worker; back up privately; changing invalidates existing ciphertext
runtimeConfiguration.pushKeySetup: pnpm push:keys mailto:operator@example.com creates NEW gitignored .env.web-push.local mode0600; copy values privately to API/worker environment
runtimeConfiguration.pushDelivery: worker polls each10s; fanout up to20 and deliveries up to20 eachpass; notification24h expiry, provider TTL300s, five networkattempts, quietretry60s; provider acceptance does not prove device receipt
runtimeConfiguration.ADMIN_WEB_ORIGIN: exact admin web origin (local http://localhost:3002); must also be listed in CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; member routes reject it unless equal to WEB_ORIGIN; empty → /v1/admin answers 503 ADMIN_NOT_CONFIGURED
runtimeConfiguration.ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY: base64 32-byte AES-256-GCM key for admin TOTP secrets; create once with pnpm admin:keys (.env.admin.local, never printed); changing it requires admin:reset-mfa
runtimeConfiguration.MAIL_OUTBOX_KEY: base64 32-byte AES-256-GCM key for the mail outbox payload; pnpm mail:keys writes gitignored .env.mail.local; same value for API and worker; required (readyz fails without it)
runtimeConfiguration.VIDEO_X264_PRESET: optional ffmpeg x264 preset from an allowlist (default veryfast); worker refuses to start on other values

groupManagement.leaveAndRemoval: retain contributed photos/comments/reactions; revoke group access immediately; LEFT may rejoin, REMOVED may not rejoin
groupManagement.ownershipTransfer: one active owner; atomic role/ownerId change; revoke all previous invitations
groupManagement.deletion: owner confirms exact current name; API 202 immediately hides group; independent worker batches 100 photos and 100 albums per pass, verified R2 cleanup before final DELETED
groupManagement.retention: group/album/photo tombstones and comment metadata retained; this is not an account-data purge
groupManagement.cleanupDelay: existing upload/processing expiry grace preserved; requires running API and separate worker
groupManagement.databaseChanges: no new migration or runtime grants required

photoMemories.datePriority: manual calendar date > EXIF DateTimeOriginal > upload date
photoMemories.calendar: fixed UTC+09:00; today/month use previous years; February 29 appears February 28 in non-leap years; today excluded from month
photoMemories.exif: explicit offset honored; missing offset assumes +09:00; malformed/future dates fall back to upload
photoMemories.permissions: current active member reads/hides own memories; uploader or active owner edits shared capture date
photoMemories.hiding: personal and reversible; album content and other members unaffected
photoMemories.verification: isolated PostgreSQL, real private R2 synthetic JPEGs, Chrome owner/member and 390px responsive viewport
photoMemories.backfill: pnpm photos:backfill-dates is dry-run; --apply --limit 100 processes bounded originals, optional --after UUID. Local woori_dev/test DB only; errors remain retryable. Existing local eligible count was 0 on 2026-10-15.

photoProcessing.limits: 30MiB per file, 30 unique files and 300MiB per browser selection; 60,000,000 decoded pixels. Exact selection duplicates removed before reservation.
photoProcessing.queue: Direct staging PUT then POST process returns 202; durable Photo queue is handled by the separate worker. Accepted processing survives page close; client-to-R2 transfer does not.
photoProcessing.recovery: Five attempts, five-minute fenced lease and 24-hour acceptance deadline; bounded exponential retry. Failed terminal jobs require selecting the file again.
photoProcessing.originals: Original bytes and EXIF/GPS preserved; display/thumbnail metadata removed. Download menu warns about original location metadata.
photoProcessing.heic: Unsupported: official synthetic HEVC HEIC metadata was readable but installed sharp/libvips could not decode pixels. Deployment-compatible decoder remains a separate decision.
photoProcessing.verification: Actual private R2 synthetic 48MP JPEG and oriented JPEG, Chrome member upload and owner viewing, reload job recovery, invalid JPEG failure, HEIC/31-file preflight, original byte equality and metadata-stripped oriented display verified.
photoProcessing.remaining: Physical iPhone/Android photo picker, save/share behavior, EXIF orientation with pin comments and deployment memory/load measurement remain unverified; W04 stays in_progress.
photoProcessing.worker: pnpm build then pnpm start:worker in a separate terminal/service; worker polls every 10s and processes up to two photos sequentially per pass. API-only startup leaves accepted jobs queued.
photoProcessing.rollback: Stop new queue acceptance, finish or terminalize queued jobs with the new worker, then restore old app. Keep additive columns; old complete endpoint cannot safely drain the new queue.
photoProcessing.reconciliation: pnpm photos:reconcile --limit 20 [--after UUID], local guarded DB only, report-only. Checks existing photo-row prefixes, skips active/recent work, verifies DB state before/after. Does not inventory prefixes whose DB row is absent. Stale attempt objects can remain; automatic orphan deletion not implemented.
photoProcessing.memory: sharp cache 32MiB, concurrency 1 and max two concurrent processing calls; these are not total process RSS limits. Benchmark combined API/worker memory before deployment.

accountSettings.revocation: Confirmation revokes all sessions, push bindings and outstanding email tokens; client clears private state and requires login and per-device push reconnection. Already handed-off provider messages cannot be recalled.
accountSettings.mail: Resend new-address confirmation and old-address notice; encrypted durable mail outbox and worker retries implemented in W07. Production delivery acceptance remains pending.

accountSettings.localMigration: 20261021000000_account_settings applied to 127.0.0.1:55439/woori_dev with explicit approval; nullable VARCHAR(254) verified, no new grants or existing-data deletion.
accountSettings.browserLimit: Desktop Chrome owner/member flows verified. Requested 390px browser viewport remained 1512px, so mobile layout and physical-device validation are not claimed. Changed-email account was confirmed and logged out; no additional post-email login was performed.

accountDeletion.scope: GET/POST /v1/auth/account-deletion; current password and exact Korean confirmation required; protected MyPage entry and public success screen.
accountDeletion.ownership: Active owned groups block deletion. Transfer ownership or request group deletion first; DELETING groups may continue asynchronously.
accountDeletion.retention: READY photos, albums, general/pin comments and reactions remain. Author is displayed as 탈퇴한 회원. Original EXIF/location and user-written personal content may remain; UI asks users to remove unwanted content before deletion.
accountDeletion.identity: Immediately replace username/email with random unusable values, clear password and verifiedAt, anonymize name. Keep internal user row for shared-content relationships; no restoration. Fresh signup with released username/email uses a new ID without old memberships.
accountDeletion.privateData: Delete sessions, email tokens, push installations, own notifications/activities/deliveries/outbox and personal preferences. Revoke issued invitations and leave memberships. Already downloaded files/provider-delivered notifications cannot be recalled.
accountDeletion.uploads: Only PENDING/PROCESSING/FAILED uploads are cancelled and queued for R2 cleanup after signed PUT/processing expiry grace; READY originals remain unchanged.
accountDeletion.concurrency: Group/membership/user/session lock order, active-user creation/join fences, group-set retry and user-before-session push registration locking.
accountDeletion.verification: Server: 18 policy, 73 unit, 84 isolated PostgreSQL integration tests including 9 account deletion cases; client: 16 policy, 85 functional tests. Types, lint/boundaries, format, builds passed. Chrome owner blocking/group-management navigation, member deletion success and other-member anonymous general/pin comment viewing verified. Actual R2 original SHA256 preserved, old and secondary sessions denied, rejoined account denied old content. Pending staging removed by worker while READY original stayed accessible.
accountDeletion.database: No schema migration. With explicit user approval, DELETE grants on 10 private-data tables applied to 127.0.0.1:55439/woori_dev; existing FOR ALL RLS retained, no data changed by grant application. Production DB untouched. Rollback permission change by revoking only these newly added DELETE grants; completed account deletion is not reversible.
accountDeletion.limits: Physical-device/mobile layout and large-account transaction duration remain unverified. API deletion transaction timeout is 30 seconds.
accountDeletion.cleanup: Synthetic group DELETED, quota zero, both test photo prefixes and staging objects absent in R2. Browser logged out; isolated fixture DB and private mail/session state removed; normal local API restored.

serviceGuidance.scope: W05 service guidance on feature/service-guidance: notices, help, inquiries, privacy summary, reports and personal blocks. OpenAPI 0.15.0.
serviceGuidance.notices: Members read PUBLISHED notices with publishedAt <= now only; no member write path; authoring is W06 admin. Runtime role has SELECT only.
serviceGuidance.inquiries: Member creates category/title/body (trimmed code points 100/2000, control/bidi characters rejected) and reads own list/detail; 5 per exact rolling 24 hours; status changes/answers are W06. Deleted immediately on account deletion.
serviceGuidance.reports: PHOTO/COMMENT/USER targets visible to the reporter; one report per reporter and target (duplicate returns 200); 20 per rolling 24 hours; operator-only handling, no notification to owner/target and no auto-hide. On reporter deletion the row keeps target/reason/status and free-text detail is erased. Runtime UPDATE limited to detail/updatedAt.
serviceGuidance.blocks: Personal and one-directional: blocker no longer sees blocked user's photos (counts/covers/list/content/memories), comments and totals, reactions, and receives no notifications/push caused by them; blocked user is not notified and group membership is unchanged. Block erases existing blocker<-blocked notifications; unblock restores content only. 500 per user, 60 mutations/hour. Blocker rows deleted on blocker account deletion; rows naming a deleted user are kept.
serviceGuidance.privacy: Public help/privacy pages describe implemented behaviour only; operator, privacy officer/contact, retention, processors and effective date are null placeholders until decided.
serviceGuidance.verification: Server 18 policy/87 unit/128 isolated integration; client 16 policy/121 functional, boundaries, builds. Isolated fixture DB with actual private R2 synthetic photos and owner/member/third/outsider browser flows; iOS Simulator Mobile Safari layout (not a physical device). Two independent reviews with fixes applied.
serviceGuidance.remaining: Physical iPhone/Android and screen-reader validation, large-account erasure timing and final operator/contact/retention policies remain; W06 admin processing is implemented.
serviceGuidance.database: Additive migrations 20261022000000_service_support, 20261023000000_content_reports, 20261024000000_user_blocks and index-only 20261025000000_notification_erasure_indexes. Rollback: drop the four new tables/enums and two indexes and their migration records; completed account deletions are not reversible.

adminOperations.scope: W06 merged via PR #16 (f33dc49); implementation 031dab9; OpenAPI now 0.26.0 with W07 extensions.
adminOperations.authentication: Separate admin_accounts/admin_sessions/admin_audit_logs and cookie woori_admin_session (__Host- in production, SameSite=Strict); TOTP MFA; 8 h absolute / 30 min idle / 10 min pre-MFA; 10 min re-auth for views and sensitive actions; lockout and rate limits; first admin only via pnpm admin:create (owner connection, password via TTY or stdin).
adminOperations.requests: Admin JSON requests require X-Woori-Request: 1 and configured Origin checks. Only the dedicated native-video GET/HEAD route substitutes an exact admin Origin plus server-signed session/photo/audit-bound ticket; current session, MFA and recent reauthentication remain mandatory. Member sessions never authorize admin routes.
adminOperations.content: Notices draft/publish/schedule(≤90 days)/archive; inquiry answers/status; reports review/dismiss/resolve (DELETE_CONTENT or SUSPEND_USER, same-target auto-resolve, 409 when closed); photo (display variant only, no-store) and comment views need reason + re-auth and are audited, 120/hour per admin.
adminOperations.members: List/search with masked email, detail counts, rename, suspend/unsuspend/delete (re-auth; delete reuses member deletion core; owned groups → 409). Suspension blocks own access only; suspended members stay in rosters, report/block targets and notification actors.
adminOperations.groups: Read-only group/album/photo metadata (album photo list audited); worker, queue and mail metrics implemented in W07.
adminOperations.audit: Append-only (runtime SELECT/INSERT); metadata whitelist of enums/UUIDs; no-op mutations returning personal data write *_VIEWED.
adminOperations.grants: admin_accounts SELECT + 6 login-state columns; admin_sessions SELECT/INSERT + 7-column UPDATE; admin_audit_logs SELECT/INSERT; notices INSERT + column UPDATE; inquiries/content_reports column UPDATE.
adminOperations.remaining: User must set ADMIN_WEB_ORIGIN/ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY and create the first admin; retention periods undecided; suspended group owner limitation.
